tests.label: On a wide canvas, halfway to the right edge is already 1 unit away (black)

predict.question: On this 600×300 canvas, the right edge is 300 px from the center and the top edge only 150 px. What is **`d`** (the distance from the center) at the middle of the **right edge**?
predict.explain: **1**, the same as at the top edge, even though it's twice as far in pixels. uv stretches to −1..1 in *both* directions, so a step in x covers more pixels than the same step in y. That's why the glow is an oval.
